android: Here's how to install the RWB App on Android. It takes about a minute.
Open Chrome, and go to ronin W.B. dot in. Scroll to Get the RWB App, and tap Download Now.
Android warns about every app from outside the Play Store. Tap Download anyway. It's the official RWB file.
When the download finishes, tap Open.
If Android blocks it, tap Settings, switch on Allow from this source, and go back.
Tap Install, then Open. If Play Protect asks, choose install anyway.
Sign in with Google, using the same account you used on the RWB join form.
Tap Turn on, then Allow, to get birthdays, events, and ride news.
You're in! See you on the next ride.
ios: Here's how to add the RWB App to your iPhone. It takes under a minute.
Don't tap the link inside WhatsApp. It opens inside WhatsApp, which can't add apps. Open Safari yourself instead.
Find Safari on your Home Screen, and open it.
Tap the address bar, type ronin W.B. dot in, slash app, and tap go.
At the bottom, tap the Share button. It's the square with an arrow pointing up.
Scroll down the list, and tap Add to Home Screen.
Keep the name RWB, and tap Add.
The RWB icon is now on your Home Screen. Always open the app from this icon.
Sign in with Google, using the same account you used on the RWB join form.
Tap Turn on, then Allow. Notifications need i O S 16.4 or newer.
You're in! See you on the next ride.
